steps.name: Collect the Coupons (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Noel] in 「Underground City Tartaros」, then turn in the quest to [Titi] in 「Deborah Snowfield」.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Hello, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How have you been, Noel?

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Thanks to your help, I've been working hard, traveling between Lumen and Tartarus.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I hardly did anything.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: You helped me talk more with Melvic, and asked Beinan to arrange a meeting with Merimel halfway through Adrika...

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: And you've earned so much of Medea's trust.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Come to think of it, the Kali people talked a lot about trust.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Medea asked me to give you her regards.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: So she's been wondering about me too. Please tell her I'm well, and she needn't worry.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Someday, when I have my own trading company and shop, I'll invite you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I hope that day comes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (So nothing else has happened...)

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Oh, this is a gift.
(Noel takes something from a pocket and places it in %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Something I happened to find. A special gift for you! I picked it up in the Kingdom of Jude's black market.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A stamp. Huh? There's nothing engraved on it.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Yes. An old book said that when someone trusted by the spirits does good deeds, they can use it with a spirit's help.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: (Noel stares at the stamp.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong, Noel?

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Nothing. Anyway, you know so many spirits, so I want you to have it. You're my VIP!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Noel.
(An unknown energy emanates from the ordinary-looking stamp.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I meet a spirit on the way, I'll ask about it.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Not just acquaintances, but spirit acquaintances... Amazing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have business in another village, so I'll be going.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Where to?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gerda. There's someone I need to meet in the Deborah Snowfields.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Wow, Gerda! I've never seen snow in my life. I've always wanted to visit. I hear it's wonderful.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Not now, but someday, when it's safe to travel alone, I'll go!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That day will come.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: You seem busy. Don't let me keep you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Noel.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then let's head to Titi in the Deborah Snowfields...)
(Noel watches absentmindedly until %s disappears from sight.)

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: That stamp... It must be a coincidence, right? Surely a spirit didn't secretly come and use it...

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Adventurer, watch your step... is what I wanted to say, but you've fallen in again.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: If you don't mind my asking, how many times have you fallen on the way here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Embarrassingly, three times.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Three is pretty good.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Hehe. I've fallen more than ten thousand times by now. I'm fine these days, but when I first arrived, it happened dozens of times a day.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Has it been about 360 years...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: 360 years...? Oh, right. You said the Kali village wasn't originally in Adrika.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Anyway, %s, I heard you stopped something terrible from happening in Gerda. Thank you again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was nothing.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: What brings you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea asked me to tell you she's doing well.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Huh? Medea? She's never done that before!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don't think anyone else has spoken of Medea as a child... Oh, that witch did.)

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Goodness. Medea asked you to give me her regards and say she's well? I can hardly believe it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it that unusual?

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Yes. Medea, being so kind... I suppose time really does change people.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: When that person disappeared... What was their name again? I...

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: ...I can't remember. Strange. I haven't forgotten Medea's name, yet I can't recall that person's...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Yes. I'm not ill or anything. Maybe I'm hungry? Sometimes being chased by Ice Otters leaves me a little dazed.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: When that happens, Galette's food usually fixes it... Oh, maybe it is the Ice Otters?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Something has definitely happened...)

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Io said she'd take me to Kali sometime, so I'll see Medea then. Once she decided to hide the village, even I, a Kali, couldn't find it.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: I wonder if anyone in Kali besides Medea still remembers me...

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Don't worry about that. Adventurer, I don't suppose you're staying here...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need to ask Narin something in the village.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: I see. Take care on the way. You do seem to fall more often than most...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be going, then. Aaaaaah!!

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: See? Slipping down again... But what was that glow in the adventurer's pocket? A jewel?

steps.name: Collect the Coupons (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Liriope] in 「Echo Spring」 and obtain the <Trust Coupon>. Then report to [Narin] in 「Gerda」.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Oh, %s. Why have you come alone? Where is Io...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She said she was going to see Atkina. I came to pass on someone's regards from Kali Village to Titi...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I see. But if you have come to me, there must be something else.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. A Kali merchant named Noel gave me this. Apparently, an old book says it's a stamp that someone trusted by the spirits can use, with a spirit's help, after doing good deeds.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: It is shining.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It is? I can't really tell... Here, take it.
(The moment the stamp passes into Narin's hand, the glow becomes clearly visible.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's the light you meant.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hmm. Did you meet a spirit on your way here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. You're the only spirit I've met, Narin.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hmm... Is that so? An object like this rarely shines...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do I use the stamp?
(Narin unfurls the scroll in hand.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I shall try it. Ah... It leaves no mark on my scroll. It must be intended for something else.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Ah! Good Deed Coupons! Good Deed Coupons!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Good Deed Coupons?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Now I remember! Long ago, spirits like me praised young spirits for their work with stamps like these.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: For example, ten stamps on a Good Deed Coupon might earn a gift, or promotion from apprentice spirit to full spirit...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: But as for using it for humans, as that old book describes, I do not know. Nor where the coupons might be... Ah!

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Echo Spring. I seem to remember many coupons scattered around the spring...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Echo Spring...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: If you retrieve them, I believe they could be of use to you, Adventurer...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How many should I bring?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Three should suffice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go and look.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: It is not urgent. Please take your time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I only meant to pass on some greetings and received a stamp. Now one thing keeps leading to another. I'll go when I'm ready...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Do I get something if the coupon is stamped?)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: %s, I never imagined these would actually still be there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Neither did I. Here are the coupons, Narin...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: One of the three appears to have belonged to Liriope.
(Narin accepts the coupons and looks saddened, as though sensing something.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: What that child wished for...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Was repentance from the master she trusted and followed.
(Narin stamps the coupon said to be Liriope's. It slowly turns to droplets, disperses, and vanishes.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: ...Well done, child. Let us meet again in a new form someday. As Liriope who lives only for herself, not for Echo or anyone else.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I, Narin, who was your family, will remember you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Two remain now.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I shall keep one and make it like those the other spirits once held. Then I can share them when someone does a good deed, or something good happens.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: The other is for you now, Adventurer. Please accept it for your good deeds.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure I'd call them good deeds...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: They are more than enough. Here.
(Narin gives %s a coupon filled with stamps, then slips the other inside the scroll.)
(Strangely, the coupon placed in the scroll begins to glow and disappears.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I do not know what this coupon will grant, but it will help you find what you currently seek, %s.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Since you came to meet someone of the Kali, perhaps something connected to them will appear.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You knew?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: You mentioned Titi and a Kali merchant. I merely guessed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Should I make a wish to a god, then?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Do as you wish, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll try.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I hold Narin's coupon between both hands and close my eyes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What a strange feeling...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As though Iris is about to give me an answer...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (An unfamiliar shape appears in my mind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A rock? It's moving... A golem? It seems self-aware... Is someone commanding it?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The shape's name slips from my mouth before I realize it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Madori? Anyway!

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: What is Maduri?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maduri... no, Madori is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I explain to Narin that Madori is a magic golem who travels with a certain girl.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: It is rare to find a master of a self-aware golem.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go see Maduri's... no, Madori's owner.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Oh, %s. May I continue to keep this stamp?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. You need it more than I do. Still, Noel gave it to me in trust, so I'll explain that I left it with a Spirit King.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Please tell the owner of that golem, Maduri, that the spirits' blessing is upon them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. I'll be going, Narin.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Um, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Oh, never mind. I shall tell you another time. I need to think a little...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go. Thank you, Narin.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: No, it is I who thank you. May your journey be peaceful.
